cases.image: Photoreal close-up of a tarnished brass compass closed on a warm walnut table. One lid, one fixed tabletop, soft side light.
cases.motion: The existing brass lid slowly opens on its hinge and reveals the intact compass dial. The camera makes one slow push toward the dial.

cases.image: One matte ceramic tile on a black table, half covered by a thin veil of water under a warm side light. Locked macro camera.
cases.motion: Water slides in one continuous sheet off the same ceramic tile, revealing its glazed surface. The tile and camera stay still.

cases.image: One small fogged glass window set into a dark wooden frame, soft sunlight behind it, close view.
cases.motion: Condensation slowly clears in the center of the same glass window, exposing a soft amber light behind it. The camera remains locked.

cases.image: Rounded 3D toy robot with a blue shell stands next to a large brass key in a warmly lit greenhouse. One character, full-body framing.
cases.motion: The same blue robot takes two slow steps and lifts the large brass key. Track the robot gently from the side. Keep its shape and blue shell consistent.

cases.image: A small stylized clay fox with a white-tipped tail stands at the start of a short wooden bridge, morning light, one continuous setting.
cases.motion: The fox walks slowly across the bridge and stops on the other side. The camera follows gently while the white tail tip and face remain consistent.

cases.image: A small 3D paper robot with one yellow satchel stands at the foot of a low stair, warm studio light, wide framing.
cases.motion: The paper robot takes one step up onto the low stair and looks up. Preserve the yellow satchel and proportions. One gentle camera rise.

cases.image: Product macro of a single unbranded graphite pocket speaker, clean silhouette on a warm oak table. The indicator ring is off.
cases.motion: The speaker rotates slowly in place while the same indicator ring lights up once. Maintain the product shape and all hardware details.

cases.image: One small original brushed-metal folding lamp with a single obvious hinge, closed on a dark wooden table.
cases.motion: The existing large panel on the lamp opens slowly on its hinge and releases a warm glow. Use a static side view.

cases.image: An original retro device with one large circular amber dial, no markings, sitting on a matte dark plinth, warm side lighting.
cases.motion: The device stays fixed while the circular dial glows softly. The camera makes a slow arc around the device, keeping its shape stable.
